Definition: Jehoram, the name of a Syrian and of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehoram is the name of a Syrian and of three Israelites, and two of them were kings. In 1 Kings 22:50, Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers. The fuller story is told on the Jehoram, King of Judah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Jehoram is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
